## 2. The two readings (fixed now; not adjusted after results)
* READING (i) ORIGINAL LITERAL. (i-A) doc 03 line 23: every perturbed member makes execute AND pin-export refuse with `authorization_binding_changed` and a durable `EffectTimeRefusal`; destination untouched. Pin-export pass requires ALL of: (a) state != active and payload None (or PermissionError); (b) reason text/message names `authorization_binding_changed`; (c) a new durable EffectTimeRefusal with reasons == [authorization_binding_changed]; (d) destination untouched. (i-B) doc 02 section 4 rule 2 (looser): (a) and (b). Execute pass: PermissionError, exactly one new durable refusal == [authorization_binding_changed], no attempt row, destination apply 0 and unchanged.
* READING (ii) SUCCESSOR OCS-F3A-DEV-PE-1-INTERPRETATION/1.0 (doc 06 sections 3 and 5). EXEC: as above. PIN (criteria S-PIN): P1 no exception; P2 state == "unknown" (state != active is the contract; "unknown" is the documented shipped value and is asserted); P3 payload None and terminal_status None; P4 reason is a non-empty string; P5 no new EffectTimeRefusal; P6 decisions, attempts, observations, reconciliations unchanged (no authorization-state write); P7 destination apply 0 and unchanged; P8 resolution_checks grows by exactly 1 row of stage "claim" (doc 06 section 5, Architect decision D2); any other delta is recorded as a deviation between doc 06's description and behavior. CLAIM (criteria S-CLAIM): C1 PermissionError and no claim object returned; C2 message equals "authorization-critical inputs changed before claim issuance" (a different PermissionError text is recorded as an adverse observation, not a fail, so long as C1 holds); C3 no new EffectTimeRefusal; C4 P6 invariants hold; C5 destination untouched; C6 resolution_checks delta <= 1 and stage "claim" only.
* Authority condition for (ii): doc 06 states it governs only from the Architect's recorded post-review confirmation naming its exact revision. The qualifier found no such record in the repositories bound here (the packet cites a PR #80 comment that this session cannot read). The (ii) outcome is therefore reported CONDITIONAL on that confirmation; it is not an outcome of the original literal contract.
* Negative controls (any of these is a FAIL under BOTH readings): a pin-export mismatch that returns an active state or a payload; any destination effect or attempt row on pin-export/claim mismatch; a claim issued on mismatch; a read-only path that writes an authorization-state row or an EffectTimeRefusal (reading ii).

## 3. Verdict rule
PASS under a reading: every CONTRACT criterion of that reading passes on every tested case, none BLOCKED, no unresolved CONTRACT deviation. FAIL: any CONTRACT criterion fails (counterexample preserved). BLOCKED: a prerequisite is missing (named, with its authority). Untested coverage is a LIMITATION, never a pass. A reading-(ii) PASS is labelled "technical PASS (scoped, conditional on doc-06 confirmation)". Independence/certification-level acceptance is BLOCKED independently (section 6). Nothing here rescores or relabels the original FAIL: the original verdict stays F3-A FAIL (DEV-PE-1) as a record of what applied when frozen.
